review.scope: implementation and leakage review against frozen baseline
review.claim: code review only; no model training, measurement quality or acceptance claimed

preconditions: Batch069 finalizer receipt and latest ledger/queue hashes agree
processable original continuation queue empty; isolated unfinished contexts explicitly excluded
latest compatible labels and all training/evaluation memberships frozen before fit
all final1331 and legacy hash holdouts excluded from every target fit
settings: original TF-IDF and LinearSVC settings unchanged, including class_weight balanced
shared_features: one fitted transformer and training matrix per identical ordered training input; one evaluation transform per transformer and ordered evaluation input
evaluation: positive and negative class metrics, true and predicted positive shares, existing frame arms and prior-exposure subsets
